title: Asymptotic stability of steady states for the compressible Navier-Stokes-Riesz system in the presence of vacuum
summary: We consider a one-dimensional physical vacuum free boundary problem on the compressible Navier-Stokes-Riesz system for an attractive Riesz potential $|x|^{2s-1}/(2s-1)$ with $0<s<1/2$. It is proved that for the adiabatic constant $γ$ satisfying $2(1-s)<γ<1+2s/3$ under the additional condition that $3/8<s<1/2$, there exists a unique global-in-time strong solution.
